items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: Sheila Jordan told me a pretty horrific story about the racial atmosphere in Detroit

ctx.x: Untouchable. Like you know the gods have just descended.

Sheila Jordan told me a pretty horrific story about the racial atmosphere in Detroit that would have been — she’s somewhat older of course, but did you witness anything like that going to those clubs with your father?

Yes, only in the sense of like I often would be the only white person within a few miles, not only of the club but like in the entire neighborhood. And I remember the first time I went, there was a famous trumpet player Marcus Belgrave who kind of was like helped oh like Kenny Garrett, Geri Allen, Robert Hurst, a lot of people played with him and he kind of like continued that lineage of like Donald Byrd and Yusef Lateef and Charles McPherson and all those amazing, you know Elvin and all those Detroit — Joe
